summary: Full backend + frontend e2e test of Cortexa. Created /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (28 pytest cases) covering health, auth (register/login/me/401 matrix on 11 protected endpoints), devices, agents CRUD + cross-user isolation, memory CRUD + user scoping, tasks add/list/patch, telemetry ranges, real Claude Sonnet 4.6 chat + session reuse + chat history + activity logging. Result: 27/28 passed (96%). Frontend Playwright: registered a fresh user -> home, verified greeting/orb/CTAs/5 quick actions/command bar, live telemetry refresh (CPU 28%->36%), 4 right-panel agents, real chat round-trip (bubble-user-0 + bubble-bot-0 'Hello there, friend!'), all 6 sidebar nav routes, Agents create+delete, Memory add+delete, Tasks add + mark done, all 8 Settings tabs, and signout -> /auth. All frontend flows passed (100%).

minor.issue: Returns 500 (not 404) for a non-existent/other-user task id. Backend log: 'TypeError: server.Task() argument after ** must be a mapping, not NoneType' - update_task builds Task(**doc) without checking doc is None. Also status_value is unvalidated free text (any string accepted, e.g. status_value=banana).
Register response echoes the email in the original casing while the DB and /auth/me return it lowercased -> inconsistent user.email between register and me.

Always returns {ok:true} even when nothing was deleted (unknown id or another user's resource). Should return 404 on deleted_count == 0. (Ownership scoping itself is correct - verified cross-user delete does not affect data.)

History replay re-sends every stored user turn to the LLM on each request (loop of send_message before the actual message). Token cost and latency grow linearly with conversation length and assistant turns are never replayed, so context is lossy/incorrect. Should pass prior turns as message history instead of re-invoking the model.

issues: When /api/activity is empty the panel renders hardcoded fake entries ('VS Code opened', 'Arduino project loaded', 'File organized', 'System cleaned') with fake relative timestamps. Misleading; should show an empty state.
Agent name and role wrap to 2-3 lines in the 320px column ('Developer Agent' / 'Coding, VS Code, Git'), making rows uneven. Consider truncation with ellipsis.
Tab labels (Account/AI/Voice/...) use var(--text-dim) on near-black - low contrast, likely below WCAG AA.
Content area is almost entirely empty on the About tab (one line of text in a full-height panel) - large dead space.
data-testid="user-menu-trigger" immediately calls logout() on click with no menu or confirmation - accidental sign-out risk and the testid name does not match behaviour.

action_items: Fix PATCH /api/tasks/{id}: return 404 when the task doc is None; validate status_value against pending|running|done|failed.
Normalize email casing in the register response (use body.email.lower()) so it matches /auth/me.
Return 404 from DELETE /api/agents/{id} and DELETE /api/memory/{id} when deleted_count == 0.
Rework /api/chat history handling to not re-send prior user turns to the LLM (cost/latency/context bug).
Replace the hardcoded fake Recent Activity fallback in RightPanel.jsx with a real empty state.
Populate /app/memory/test_credentials.md - it is currently empty (only comment headers); daniyal@cortexa.ai / CortexaPass!23 was supplied via the review request only.
Optional: raise contrast of Settings tab labels; make user-menu-trigger open a menu instead of instant logout.
critical_code_review_comments: update_task does Task(**doc) without a None guard -> guaranteed 500 on any unknown id (confirmed in backend.err.log).
/api/chat replays history by calling send_message per stored user message - O(n) LLM calls per request and assistant turns are dropped.
Delete endpoints ignore delete_one().deleted_count so clients cannot distinguish success from no-op.
JWT_SECRET falls back to the literal 'dev-secret' when unset; fail fast instead of shipping a default secret.
@app.on_event('shutdown') is deprecated in current FastAPI; migrate to a lifespan handler.
RightPanel.jsx swallows all API errors with `catch (_) {}` - no error state is ever surfaced to the user if telemetry/agents/activity calls fail.

rca_of_the_issue: PATCH /api/tasks/{id} 500: update_task runs update_one then find_one; when the id does not exist (or belongs to another user) find_one returns None and Task(**None) raises TypeError, which FastAPI surfaces as a 500. Repro: PATCH /api/tasks/<random-uuid>?status_value=done with a valid Bearer token. Fix: if doc is None -> raise HTTPException(404, 'Task not found').
